title: The Lost Mitten You Called Stolen
youtube_title: The Lost Mitten You Called Stolen | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Lior is tangled up with a mitten you dropped and almost called stolen and almost hides it. Lior tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
